jobs.description:
Zymofix is a dynamic and innovative startup dedicated to fostering sustainable and circular agriculture. We specialize in creating effective and economically viable microbial products designed to reduce farmers' reliance on agrochemicals while maintaining high productivity. Positioned at the forefront of sustainable agriculture, we are committed to delivering cutting-edge solutions that empower farmers to grow healthy crops and improve yields without resorting to chemical fertilizers. Zymofix is planning the construction of an industrial-scale demonstration plant in 2027.
 

 
 

Job Description & Key Responsibilities
 

We are looking for a Pilot Plant Technician with a critical mindset to join our team. You will be responsible for:
 
 

• Operating, maintaining, and analyzing the existing pilot plant installations, covering substrate production, the fermentation section, laboratory analysis, and downstream processing 

• Production of fermentation substrates using a novel thermophysical pretreatment system. 

• Cultivation of microorganisms in several pilot-scale solid-state fermenters. 

• Managing and maintaining the equipment/machine park, carrying out both preventive and reactive maintenance, including troubleshooting technical issues. 

• Assisting with small-scale construction projects (e.g. installing drying ovens, cleanroom ventilation), sometimes coordinating with external contractors. 

• Providing onsite assistance for larger new-build projects as the pilot plant expands.  

 
 

 

You might be our perfect match if you meet the requirements below. But don't worry if you don't tick every box, we dare you to apply anyway. You never know if there’s another role at Zymofix that's a better fit for your skills.
 
 

• A technical bachelor's degree, or equivalent through relevant experience; a degree specifically in (electro)mechanics, biochemistry, or a related field is a plus. 

• Strong mechanical aptitude, troubleshooting skills, and basic electrical knowledge; basic knowledge of engines/motors is an additional asset. 

• The ability to read and interpret technical documents, equipment manuals, and process diagrams. 

• Strong problem-solving abilities and a hands-on approach to technical challenges. 

• Willingness and ability to work safely in hazardous environments (chemicals, high-pressure systems, pilot plants), with strict adherence to safety protocols; proven experience in this area, with a track record of promoting a safety-first culture and taking ownership of on-the-spot hazard assessments, is a plus. 

• Experience with lab analysis and working with microorganisms; knowledge of fermentation processes and hygiene practices is a plus. 

• Fluency in English, both verbal and written; fluency in Dutch is a plus.  

The role requires strong technical skills, a high degree of independence, and the ability to collaborate effectively with a multidisciplinary team. You draw energy from collective success.

Zymofix is a dynamic and innovative scale-up dedicated to fostering sustainable and circular agriculture. We specialize in creating effective and economically viable microbial products designed to reduce farmers' reliance on agrochemicals while maintaining high levels of productivity. 
 

We are looking for a Project Engineer with a critical mindset to reinforce our engineering team. You will be responsible for:
 
 

• Project execution & follow-up: Oversee and follow up on the execution of small- and large-scale engineering projects from conception to completion. Most notably the construction of our new industrial-scale demo plant. You’ll work closely with, and supported by, our external engineering partner who handles the detailed engineering, contractor selection, and tendering. You keep a close eye on progress, quality, and budget, since final decision-making stays with Zymofix. 

• Stakeholder & partner management: Collaborate closely with internal teams and external partners, engineers, and contractors, acting as a key point of contact and coordinator to keep everyone aligned and projects running smoothly. 

• Demo industrial plant construction: Co-prepare and guide the construction of the new demo industrial facility for micro-organism production. 

• Production run coordination: Organize and coordinate production runs carried out with our external partner in Spain, arranging transport and communication. 

• Relocation management: Help prepare and lead the relocation and scale-up of current operational activities to our new site. For example, contributing to the layout and flow of the new facility, in close consultation with other internal departments.  

 

You might be our perfect match if you meet the requirements below. But don't worry if you don't tick every box, we dare you to apply anyway. You never know if there’s another role at Zymofix that's a better fit for your skills.
 
 

• A technical bachelor's degree, or equivalent through relevant experience, with a proven track record in project execution; a master's degree in engineering or a related field is a plus. 

• Experience in process engineering and project management; biochemical process know-how (process and equipment design at industrial scale) is a plus. 

• Strong technical aptitude, troubleshooting skills, and a hands-on approach to solving technical challenges. 

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, comfortable collaborating with and reporting to internal and external parties. 

• Experience managing contractors and other third parties, supported by a broad professional network. 

• A structured way of working, able to keep a helicopter view while staying on top of the details, with a drive to deliver on ambitious timelines. 

• A proactive coordinator who spots problems early and works to resolve them. 

• Fluency in English, both verbal and written; fluency in Dutch is a plus.  

The role requires strong technical and problem-solving skills, a high degree of independence, and the ability to collaborate effectively with a multidisciplinary team. You draw energy from collective success.

Zymofix is a dynamic and innovative scale-up dedicated to fostering sustainable and circular agriculture. We specialize in creating effective and economically viable microbial products designed to reduce farmers' reliance on agrochemicals while maintaining high levels of productivity. Positioned at the forefront of sustainable agriculture, we are committed to delivering cutting-edge solutions that empower farmers to cultivate healthy products and enhance their yields without resorting to chemical fertilizers. Zymofix is planning the construction of an industrial-scale demonstration plant in 2027.
 

Job Description & Key Responsibilities
We are looking for a Scale-up Engineer with a critical mindset to reinforce our engineering team. You will be responsible for:
 
 

• Operating, maintaining, and troubleshooting the current pilot plant installations, including production of fermentation substrates using our novel thermophysical pretreatment system. 

• Writing up and scheduling the tests required for process development, and planning and helping carry out production runs for both process development and client projects. 

• Expanding and maintaining the new pilot plant by identifying, designing, and building new process units: commissioning new equipment, drafting operating procedures and manuals, and developing improvement proposals. 

• Ensuring safety throughout all pilot plant operations. 

• Producing for clients while building the internal knowledge needed to scale up — reviewing current small-scale processes and equipment, assessing scale-up potential, performing risk analyses, and taking part in the construction and engineering of the new industrial plant, including the commissioning team. 

• Depending on your profile and interests, the exact task package can be shaped around your strengths. 

You might be our perfect match if you meet the requirements below. But don't worry if you don't tick every box, we dare you to apply anyway. You never know if there’s another role at Zymofix that's a better fit for your skills.
 
 

• A bachelor's or master's degree in (bio)chemistry, process engineering, or a related field; a background in electromechanical engineering is also considered, particularly when combined with relevant hands-on experience in a similar field. 

• A hands-on, practical way of working. 

• Experience in process engineering and project management. 

• Fermentation know-how: process and equipment design from lab to industrial scale; experience with large-scale/pilot-scale fermentation (from 50 L) is a plus. 

• Proven experience working safely in hazardous environments (chemicals, high-pressure systems, pilot plants) with strict adherence to safety protocols. 

• Demonstrate ownership in last-minute hazard evaluations and leadership in promoting a safety-first culture. 

• Strong mechanical aptitude, troubleshooting skills, basic electrical knowledge, and affinity with biochemical processes. Knowledge of automation is a plus. 

• Ability to read, interpret, and create technical documents, equipment manuals, and process diagrams. 

• Strong problem-solving abilities and a hands-on approach to addressing technical challenges. 

• Experience with lab analysis and working with microorganisms. 

• Fluency in English and Dutch (both verbal and written).  

The role requires strong technical skills, a high degree of independence, and the ability to collaborate effectively with a multidisciplinary team. You draw energy from collective success.

At NHV, we keep aviation moving! As a Transport Planner, you’ll play a key role in ensuring that critical aircraft parts and supplies reach their destinations—on time and efficiently.

You’ll coordinate, monitor, and optimize transport activities (including customs clearance) across our network, balancing operational urgency with cost-efficiency. This is a fast-paced role where your decisions directly support flight operations and safety.

You report to the Transport Coordinator.

Occasional travel to other NHV bases may be required.

Tasks & Responsibilities:

• 
Plan and coordinate transport activities in the most efficient and cost-effective way

• 
Monitor shipments end-to-end, ensuring timely pickup and delivery

• 
Register and track transports in our ERP system

• 
Collaborate with engineers and planners to challenge and optimize delivery timelines

• 
Consolidate shipments where possible to reduce costs

• 
Manage urgent/AOG shipments, including obtaining stakeholder approval

• 
Handle dangerous goods shipments (via FedEx or other platforms)

• 
Resolve transport-related issues, including delivery delays and invoice discrepancies

• 
Continuously look for improvements to reduce cost and enhance logistics processes

• 
Work in line with standard operating procedures (SOPs)

• 
Comply with all Information Security Management System (ISMS) policies and procedures and take personal responsibility for protecting company information and assets.

• 
Experience in a transport, logistics or supply chain environment is a plus but not essential

• 
Knowledge of customs processes (UK) is a plus

• 
Experience in aviation is an advantage

• 
Strong organizational and prioritization skills

• 
A proactive problem-solver with attention to detail

• 
Confident communicator with strong coordination abilities

• 
Comfortable with IT systems (ERP or aviation tools are a plus)

• 
Fluent in English (professional level required)

• 
Knowledge of IATA Dangerous Goods regulations is an asset

• 
Take initiative and ownership and you’re a problem solver

• 
Work well in a team and communicate clearly

• 
Thrive in a dynamic, operational environment

• 
Have a cost-conscious mindset

• 
Are reliable, accurate, adaptable, and eager to learn

Already living in Belgium and looking for a stable logistics job?

Do you enjoy physical work? Do you have experience in a warehouse or logistics environment? And are you comfortable working in a cold environment? Then this could be your next long-term opportunity!

For a leading logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for motivated warehouse workers to join the team. You will help distribute frozen food products to supermarkets across Belgium and Europe while working in a modern logistics environment where English is fully accepted.

Your role

As a warehouse worker, you are an important part of the logistics process. Using an electric pallet truck (EPT), you help ensure that products are received, stored and shipped correctly.

Your responsibilities include:

• Loading and unloading trucks
• Performing quality checks on incoming and outgoing goods
• Keeping the warehouse organised and safe
After a while, you can also receive internal reach truck training and expand your responsibilities.

You're a good fit if you:

• Have previous experience in warehouse or logistics
• Have experience with an electric pallet truck (EPT)
• Can work in a 2-shift system
• Aren't afraid of working in cold environments
• Have your own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)
So please don't hesitate to apply if you meet these requirements!

Reach truck experience is a big plus but not mandatory.

jobs.description:
Already living in Belgium and looking for a stable logistics job?

Are you a true night owl who performs best during the night? Do you already have some experience in warehouse work or logistics? And are you looking for a stable employer with a lot of job security? Then this could be the perfect job for you!

For a leading logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for motivated warehouse workers to join the team in the night shift. You will help distribute frozen food products to supermarkets across Belgium and Europe while working in a modern logistics environment where English is fully accepted.

Your role

As a warehouse operator, you are an important part of the logistics process. Using an electrical pallet truck (EPT), you help ensure that products are received, stored and shipped correctly.

Your responsibilities include:

• Loading and unloading trucks

• Performing quality checks on incoming and outgoing goods

• Keeping the warehouse organised and safe

Reach truck experience is a big plus but not required.

Jimber is looking for an experienced inside sales professional who can open new accounts, qualify commercial potential and develop prospects into concrete sales opportunities. You will work closely with marketing and our account executives while taking clear ownership of your own pipeline.
 

Your responsibilities

- Build and manage outbound activity for selected accounts and sectors.

- Identify and approach relevant decision-makers by phone, LinkedIn, email and at events.

- Start credible commercial conversations with IT managers, security leaders and IT partners.

- Understand the prospect's context, priorities and business challenges.

- Qualify commercial potential, urgency, stakeholders and next steps.

- Develop early-stage prospects into well-prepared sales opportunities.

- Follow up marketing campaigns, event contacts and partner leads.

- Maintain your pipeline and activities accurately in HubSpot.

- Work with marketing and account executives to improve messaging and conversion.
 

Primary focus

- Owning outbound activity across a defined target market.

- Building relationships and qualifying commercial potential.

- Creating a reliable flow of well-developed opportunities.

- At least two years of experience in B2B inside sales or business development.

- Experience in IT, SaaS, cybersecurity or a similar B2B environment.

- A proven ability to open doors and build opportunities through outbound activity.

- Confident engaging decision-makers by phone and in writing.

- Able to explain value clearly without relying on technical jargon.

- Commercially mature, structured and comfortable taking ownership of targets.

- Fluent in Dutch and English. French is an advantage.

Jimber is looking for an experienced sales professional to develop new customers and partners in Belgium and the Netherlands. You will manage the full commercial process for our European SASE platform, from initial contact to signed contract.
 

Your responsibilities

- Identify and approach potential customers and commercial partners.

- Develop new business across Belgium and the Netherlands.

- Engage with IT managers, CISOs, executives and IT partners.

- Analyse security and networking requirements.

- Prepare demonstrations and commercial proposals with our technical team.

- Manage negotiations, procurement processes and contracts.

- Build relationships with integrators, MSPs and MSSPs.

- Maintain an accurate pipeline and forecast in HubSpot.

- Share market information and customer feedback with product and management.
 

Commercial scope

- Benelux new business development.

- Direct customers and partner-led opportunities.

- Full-cycle ownership with technical support from the Jimber team.

- At least five years of B2B sales experience in cybersecurity, networking, cloud or IT infrastructure.

- A proven track record of building and closing complex sales opportunities.

- Experience with IT integrators, MSPs, MSSPs or security vendors.

- A solid understanding of SASE, Zero Trust, ZTNA, SD-WAN and network security.

- Able to engage credibly with technical and business stakeholders.

- Fluent in Dutch and English. French is an advantage.

jobs.occupation: Customer Service DACH for the Medical Sector
jobs.description:
The role of Customer Service DACH for the medical sector involves providing effective support and assistance to customers in the life science industry. This position focuses on the Order to Cash cycle and on ensuring smooth communication and resolving customer inquiries efficiently.

Client Details

Our client is an international company specialized in medical supplies and accessories.

Description

As a Customer Service DACH for the medical sector your responsibilities are:

• Manage customer inquiries and provide accurate information in a timely manner.
• Process orders and ensure correct documentation for the medical sector.
• Coordinate with internal teams to address and resolve customer issues effectively.
• Monitor and follow up on deliveries to ensure customer satisfaction.
• Maintain accurate records of customer interactions and transactions.
• Support customers with product-related questions and technical assistance.
• Identify opportunities for process improvements within customer service operations.
• Ensure compliance with industry regulations and company policies.

A successful Customer Service DACH for the medical sector should have:

• Proficiency in German and English, both written and spoken.
• Knowledge of customer service processes and tools.
• Experience in SAP is a big plus
• Strong organisational and problem-solving skills.
• Attention to detail and ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
• Customer-oriented mindset with excellent communication skills.

Jimber is a Belgian cybersecurity company with its own software platform and ambitious growth plans. We are looking for a marketer who helps determine our market strategy, sharpens our story and turns it into visibility, interest and qualified sales opportunities.
 

Your responsibilities

- Shape positioning, priority markets and go-to-market plans with management.

- Build campaigns that generate qualified leads and sales opportunities.

- Translate technical topics into clear content for customers and partners.

- Manage our website, LinkedIn, email marketing, SEO and events.

- Develop customer stories, product launches and partner campaigns.

- Equip sales with presentations, cases and commercial content.

- Track performance in HubSpot and improve campaigns based on data.

- Coordinate external creatives and specialists when needed.
 

AI-enabled execution

- Use AI for market, competitor and customer research.

- Create and repurpose content with strong quality control.

- Build AI-assisted workflows for campaigns, lead generation and reporting.

- Automate repetitive work and scale what proves effective.

- At least four years of experience in B2B marketing.

- Experience in SaaS, IT or cybersecurity.

- Strong strategic thinking and hands-on execution.

- Excellent writing skills in English and Dutch.

- Practical experience with generative AI and marketing automation.

- Comfortable with CRM, analytics and longer B2B sales cycles.
